title: The Return v9 (hero-intro structure, electronic lead, Carnatic as support)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: Dark modern Tamil mass-hero introduction film score. Electronic sounds lead: a gritty but clean synth lead carries the main 4-bar heroic theme and a thick steady synth bass drives the whole track; a cinematic body of low brass and low strings holds dark sustained chords underneath. Carnatic instruments are support only, never the lead: a veena answers the theme with fast ornamented gamaka runs and a mridangam adds syncopated fills, sitting behind the synth lead in the mix. 108 BPM half-time swagger, C sharp minor with menacing chromatic half-step bends, in the mood of Carnatic Raga Shanmukhapriya. Vocals: only deep male crowd chants and wordless shouts between phrases, no lyrics, no singer. Structure of a hero entry: 0-12 s the tease, the hero is not seen yet: a low synth drone, a ticking electronic pulse and a steady sub bass, crowd chants rising, the theme only hinted at; quieter but never empty. 12-14 s the reveal: one huge processed hit, a split-second hold, then the full hook on the synth lead. 14-40 s the swagger walk: the synth lead theme returns every 4 bars over the synth bass and brass, the veena answers, the mridangam fills, chants answer each phrase. 40-52 s the mass moment: everything together, synth lead and brass on the theme, veena runs as a third layer, full chants. 52-60 s the punch: a short stinger and one hard final hit. Steady sustained sub bass that never cuts out, no side-chain pumping, no EDM drops; clear, tonal, punchy, very loud cinematic mix; no white-noise sweeps, no harsh fuzz, no even sixteenth-note hi-hat rolls.

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.lead: nadaswaram (the hero's voice), with solo cello and bansuri for memory
cues: 0-12 s  Tease: hero unseen; low synth drone, ticking electronic pulse, steady sub, crowd chants rising, theme only hinted on the synth lead
12-14 s  Reveal: one huge processed hit, a split-second hold, then the full hook on the synth lead
14-40 s  Swagger walk: synth lead theme every 4 bars over synth bass and the brass/low-string body; veena answers the theme, mridangam fills; chants answer
40-52 s  Mass moment: everything, synth lead and brass on the theme, veena gamaka runs as the third layer, full chant
52-60 s  Punch: short stinger and one hard final hit

story: A hero walks back into his city after many years away. The city half-remembers him; then the whole street knows he is back.
